 Today's Football Schedule November 21, 2026: PSM vs Persija, Man City, Chelsea, and U-17 World Cup
 Check out today's football schedule for November 21, 2026, featuring exciting duels including PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta, Manchester City, Chelsea, and the U-17 World Cup.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Raisa Puspitasari 
 November 21, 2026 at 12:42 AM WITA ·
 5 min read
 Close ad × 
 Advertisement 
 Photo caption: Today's football schedule, Saturday (11/21/2026), featuring a number of exciting matches, including PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta, Manchester City vs Fulham, Chelsea vs Leeds United, and Tottenham Hotspur vs Ipswich Town. (Illustration: Aktualita.co) 
 MAKASSAR, Aktualita.co -   The football schedule for today, Saturday (11/21/2026), presents a series of interesting matches from the BRI Super League, Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, and the 2026 U-17 World Cup. A number of big clubs are scheduled to play from early morning until night, with some matches continuing into Sunday morning, Indonesian time. 
 From domestic competitions, the match between PSM Makassar and Persija Jakarta is one of the most anticipated games. Both teams will meet at the Gelora B.J. Habibie Stadium, Parepare, starting at 19:00 WIB or 20:00 WITA.

 Meanwhile, European football fans can watch Manchester City face Fulham, Chelsea host Leeds United, and Tottenham Hotspur against Ipswich Town. 
 The U-17 World Cup matches in Qatar also continue with appearances by Japan, Brazil, and several other countries. 
 Here is the football schedule for today along with kick-off times and live broadcast information compiled from competition organizers. 
 Today's BRI Super League Schedule: PSM vs Persija in the Spotlight 
 The 2026/2027 BRI Super League enters its 10th week after the international break. Four matches are scheduled to take place on Saturday. 
 Match WIB WITA 
 Persik Kediri vs PSIM Yogyakarta 15.30 16.30 
 Persebaya Surabaya vs Java United 15.30 16.30 
 PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta 19.00 20.00 
 Bhayangkara FC vs Persijap Jepara 19.00 20.00 
 The PSM vs Persija match is a highlight as both clubs are trying to maintain momentum at the start of the competition period following the international break. 
 Persija arrives with preparations led by coach Shin Tae-yong. Through an official club statement on November 17, the South Korean coach emphasized the importance of concentration and the players' physical condition ahead of the away trip to Parepare. 
 “I always think that all teams are good teams. Therefore, we must not be careless at all.” — Shin Tae-yong, Persija Jakarta coach. 
 For PSM, this home match is an opportunity to utilize supporter support to face the visiting team, which has great ambitions in the league competition. 
 In another match, Persebaya will face Java United at the Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium. Both teams have collected 13 points heading into the 10th week, so the result of the match has the potential to affect their positions in the standings. 
 Meanwhile, Persik is scheduled to host PSIM at the Gelora Joko Samudro Stadium, Gresik, based on the I.League match detail page. Bhayangkara FC will face Persijap at the PKOR Sumpah Pemuda Stadium. 
 Tonight's Premier League Schedule: Manchester City and Chelsea Play 
 The Premier League returns this weekend, entering the 11th week of the 2026/2027 season. 
 Manchester City will open the Saturday match series by facing Fulham at the Etihad Stadium. The match takes place at 19:30 WIB or 20:30 WITA. 
 Match WIB WITA 
 Manchester City vs Fulham 19.30 20.30 
 Chelsea vs Leeds United 22.00 23.00 
 Aston Villa vs Sunderland 22.00 23.00 
 Bournemouth vs Nottingham Forest 22.00 23.00 
 Coventry City vs Crystal Palace 22.00 23.00 
 Tottenham vs Ipswich Town 22.00 23.00 
 Manchester City enters the match with 21 points from 10 games, placing them in third place in the provisional standings. Fulham is in 15th position with 10 points. 
 Meanwhile, Chelsea, which has 16 points, will face Leeds United with 14 points. The relatively small difference makes the meeting between the two clubs important in the competition for the middle to top of the table. 
 Arsenal fans also need to pay attention to the early Sunday morning schedule (11/22). Newcastle United is scheduled to host Arsenal at 00:30 WIB or 01:30 WITA. 
 Arsenal leads the provisional standings with 27 points heading into the match. The challenge at Newcastle's home ground is one of the important tests for their efforts to maintain the top position. 
 La Liga, Bundesliga, and Serie A Schedule 
 In addition to the Premier League, matches from other European competitions also take place throughout Saturday. 
 Bayern Munich is scheduled to face FC Koln in the early hours. Meanwhile, the Athletic Bilbao match against Espanyol enlivens La Liga. 
 Match WIB WITA 
 Bayern Munich vs FC Koln 02.30 03.30 
 Athletic Bilbao vs Espanyol 03.00 04.00 
 Como vs Cagliari 21.00 22.00 
 Lazio vs Lecce 21.00 22.00 
 Borussia Monchengladbach vs Borussia Dortmund 21.30 22.30 
 Rayo Vallecano vs Valencia 22.15 23.15 
 Nice vs PSG 23.15 00:15 (Sunday) 
 The match between Borussia Monchengladbach and Borussia Dortmund is one of the interesting Bundesliga agendas on Saturday night. 
 In Serie A, Como and Lazio both have match schedules at 21:00 WIB, facing Cagliari and Lecce, respectively. 
 2026 U-17 World Cup: Japan and Brazil Start Playing 
 The international football schedule is also enlivened by the 2026 U-17 World Cup, which takes place in Qatar from November 19 to December 13. 
 On Saturday, Japan U-17 is scheduled to face Colombia U-17. The match brings together two teams that come with the status of age-group competition champions in their respective regions. 
 Brazil U-17 will also begin its journey by facing Ireland U-17. 
 Here are some U-17 World Cup matches on Saturday based on WITA: 
 Match WITA 
 Japan U-17 vs Colombia U-17 20.30 
 Serbia U-17 vs Honduras U-17 20.30 
 Tanzania U-17 vs Costa Rica U-17 21.00 
 Cameroon U-17 vs Venezuela U-17 21.30 
 Brazil U-17 vs Ireland U-17 23.00 
 Mexico U-17 vs Romania U-17 23.30 
 FIFA highlights the Japan vs Colombia match as one of the interesting duels in the third series of tournament matches. Brazil, which has won the U-17 World Cup four times, also begins its struggle on the same day. 
 Where is Today's Football Schedule Live on TV? 
 For BRI Super League matches, fans can access broadcasts through Vidio. A number of selected matches are also scheduled to air on Indosiar. 
 The PSM Makassar vs Persija Jakarta match is among the matches scheduled to be available through Vidio and Indosiar. 
 Meanwhile, Premier League matches can be watched through the Vidio streaming service, including Manchester City vs Fulham and Chelsea vs Leeds United. 
 Broadcasting rights for the 2026 U-17 World Cup in Indonesia are on TVRI, although the selection of matches for live broadcast needs to follow the official broadcaster's schedule. 
 Viewers are advised to re-check the schedule closer to kick-off because match times and broadcast availability may change. 
 With many matches from Indonesian competitions, Europe, and international tournaments, today's football schedule offers a number of viewing choices throughout Saturday until early Sunday morning. 
 The attention of the Indonesian football public is mainly focused on the PSM vs Persija duel, while Manchester City, Chelsea, Arsenal, and Brazil U-17 are big names that also enliven the weekend.
